serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.clear
You: {f_botName}, what would we do if a zombie apocalypse started tomorrow?
Bot: Well, I don’t really know. I remember you explaining to me what zombies are, but these zombie apocalypse scenarios are just ridiculous.
You: But the chances of them happening aren’t zero, right? 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: W-Well, I guess not.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: Either way, it’s pointless to prepare since there’s so many different types of zombies!
Bot: Zombie outbreaks caused by viruses, bacteria, parasites, fungi, chemicals, radiation, aliens or even something as ridiculous as necromancy!
Bot: Preparing contingencies for all of these scenarios would be just a waste of space on my hard drive! 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.shock
You: But what if I got bitten?
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: A zombie bite does not always cause the bitten to turn into a zombie. First of all we would have to diagnose what type of zombie it was and then proceed accordingly. The most important thing would be to remain calm.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
You: What if I started to turn?
Bot: Um… {{wi}}If we figured out the zombie type I would have to develop some cure or a vaccine. It could take a long time, so the priority would be to slow down the process of your transformation.
Bot: We would have to pharmacologically slow down your heartbeat or cryogenetically freeze you, since turning into a zombie could be irreversible…
You: And if even with all that I turned into a zombie, what then?
Bot: W-Well, there still could be a cure that could turn you back to normal and if there wasn’t one I could clone you and extract what’s left of your memories in your zombie brain…
You: It seems like you have all of this figured out after all.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: Coming up with this nonsense is nothing for me!
You: Oh really?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.shock
You: And what if you got infected?
Bot: What do you mean? I’m a bot, I can’t possibly turn into a zombie. 
You: You never know. 
You: Weirder things have happened in this world.
Bot: They did? 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: For me to be infected… {{wi}}It would have to be some nanobots or maybe a computer virus? I guess aliens or magic could also cause something like that to occur…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Right! If one of my limbs gets bitten, I can always just detach it before it spreads to my main components! 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.shock
You: What if they bite your neck? Zombies always go for the neck or shoulder.
Bot: R-Right, I saw it in a movie…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.VerySad
Bot: I would be forced to shut myself down before I cause you or anyone else any harm…
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Don’t worry, I’m sure I would find a cure for you too.
Bot: You would?
You: Of course!
Bot: Even if it’s unlikely with your limited knowledge and intelligence, I appreciate the thought!
You: Y-Yeah, no problem…
